name: Nyaa+
description: Improved Nyaa provider — multi-language smart search (English, Romaji, Japanese), accurate season/episode handling, all smart-search options (batch, episode, resolution, query, best releases), instant magnets from RSS info hashes, mirror failover, live AniList episode-offset derivation (cracks SubsPlease-style continuing numbering, incl. markerless sequels), quality preferences (resolution/dual-audio), freshness-aware ordering for airing shows. Drop-in upgrade for the built-in Nyaa provider.
author: Trancezzz
